[[Doro Icehide]] is a [[Losaru]] [[Centaur]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Scar]].

* [[Losaru Elementalist Robes]]
* [[Losaru Mane]]

== Notes ==
* Doro Icehide is one of six Losaru Centaur bosses that spawns randomly at six spawn points. The spawn points are shared with [[Aguo Gruffmane]], [[Caza Windedcalf]], [[Mina Brillianthaunch]], [[Zalo Soulhaunch]], and [[Gret Waveringmane]].
* If the [[quest]] [[The Warrior's Path]] is active, [[Orshad Chieftain]] will be at one of the easternmost spawn point, thus replacing one of the normal bosses.
* Doro Icehide is the only known Losaru [[Elementalist]].
